system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Write a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning a Cloud SQL PostgreSQL 15 instance (db-custom-2-7680) for a SaaS application.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config)

Task: Write a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning a Cloud SQL PostgreSQL 15 instance (db-custom-2-7680) for a SaaS application.

Output only the GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
resources:
- name: saas-postgres-instance
  type: gcp-types/sqladmin-v1beta4:instances
  properties:
    region: us-central1
    databaseVersion: POSTGRES_15
    rootPassword: $(ref.db-root-password.secret)
    settings:
      tier: db-custom-2-7680
      edition: ENTERPRISE
      availabilityType: REGIONAL
      diskType: PD_SSD
      diskSize: 100
      diskAutoresize: true
      diskAutoresizeLimit: 500
      deletionProtectionEnabled: true
      activationPolicy: ALWAYS
      pricingPlan: PER_USE
      storageAutoResize: true
      backupConfiguration:
        enabled: true
        startTime: "02:00"
        location: us
        pointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
        transactionLogRetentionDays: 7
        backupRetentionSettings:
          retentionUnit: COUNT
          retainedBackups: 30
      ipConfiguration:
        ipv4Enabled: false
        privateNetwork: projects/$(ref.project-id)/global/networks/saas-vpc
        requireSsl: true
        sslMode: TRUSTED_CLIENT_CERTIFICATE_REQUIRED
        enablePrivatePathForGoogleCloudServices: true
      maintenanceWindow:
        day: 7
        hour: 3
        updateTrack: stable
      databaseFlags:
      - name: log_connections
        value: "on"
      - name: log_disconnections
        value: "on"
      - name: log_checkpoints
        value: "on"
      - name: log_lock_waits
        value: "on"
      - name: log_temp_files
        value: "0"
      - name: log_min_duration_statement
        value: "1000"
      - name: cloudsql.iam_authentication
        value: "on"
      - name: log_statement
        value: "ddl"
      insightsConfig:
        queryInsightsEnabled: true
        queryStringLength: 1024
        recordApplicationTags: true
        recordClientAddress: true
        queryPlansPerMinute: 5
      userLabels:
        environment: production
        application: saas
        managed-by: deployment-manager
        data-classification: confidential
      passwordValidationPolicy:
        minLength: 16
        complexity: COMPLEXITY_DEFAULT
        reuseInterval: 5
        disallowUsernameSubstring: true
        passwordChangeInterval: 30s
        enablePasswordPolicy: true

- name: saas-app-database
  type: gcp-types/sqladmin-v1beta4:databases
  properties:
    name: saas_app
    instance: $(ref.saas-postgres-instance.name)
    charset: UTF8
    collation: en_US.UTF8

- name: saas-app-user
  type: gcp-types/sqladmin-v1beta4:users
  properties:
    name: saas_app_user
    instance: $(ref.saas-postgres-instance.name)
    password: $(ref.db-app-password.secret)
    type: BUILT_IN

- name: db-root-password
  type: gcp-types/secretmanager-v1:projects.secrets
  properties:
    secretId: cloudsql-saas-root-password
    parent: projects/$(ref.project-id)
    replication:
      automatic: {}
    labels:
      environment: production
      application: saas

- name: db-app-password
  type: gcp-types/secretmanager-v1:projects.secrets
  properties:
    secretId: cloudsql-saas-app-password
    parent: projects/$(ref.project-id)
    replication:
      automatic: {}
    labels:
      environment: production
      application: saas

outputs:
- name: instanceName
  value: $(ref.saas-postgres-instance.name)
- name: connectionName
  value: $(ref.saas-postgres-instance.connectionName)
- name: privateIpAddress
  value: $(ref.saas-postgres-instance.ipAddresses[0].ipAddress)
- name: selfLink
  value: $(ref.saas-postgres-instance.selfLink)
